set system host-name PE1.explanation: Configure the host name of the device.

parameters.name: hostname
parameters.explanation: The host name of the equipment is used to identify the equipment in the network.

set protocols cfm global enable.explanation: The CFM protocol is enabled globally.

set protocols cfm md md1.explanation: Configure the maintenance domain of CFM.

parameters.name: md
parameters.explanation: Maintains the name of the domain.

ma ma1.explanation: Configure maintenance association (Maintenance Association) in the specified maintenance domain.

parameters.name: ma
parameters.explanation: Maintains the name of the association.

loss-measure send test-id 1.explanation: This command configures Connectivity Fault Management (CFM) to send loss measurement frames for a specific maintenance association (MA) using a defined test ID.

interval 1000.explanation: This command configures Connectivity Fault Management (CFM) to send loss measurement frames with a specified test ID and interval for a given maintenance domain (MD) and association (MA).

count 20.explanation: Configure the drop-out measurement, specify the test ID, the interval and the count.

set routing-instances evpna.explanation: This command fragment configures a routing instance named `[parameter1]` in Junos, allowing for separate routing tables and protocols within that instance.

parameters.name: routing-instance
parameters.explanation: Name of route example, e.g. net.

vpn-target 1:1.explanation: This command configures a VPN target (route distinguisher) for a specific routing instance, enabling route exchange within a VPN.

parameters.name: vpn-target
parameters.explanation: VPN target, to control the import and export of route.

import-extcommunity.explanation: Configures the VPN target for the route example to import.

parameters.name: bridge-domain
parameters.explanation: Bridge domain names, such as vlan10.

vlan-id 2.explanation: Configure the VLAN ID of the bridge domain.

parameters.name: vlan-id
parameters.explanation: VLAN ID, used to identify VLAN.

pppoe enable.explanation: Enable PPPE on interface (Point-to-Point Production over Ethernet).
